The 2025 Emilia Romagna Grand Prix (round 7, held at Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari on 18 May 2025) was won by Max Verstappen for Red Bull, starting from 2nd on the grid. Lando Norris (McLaren) was second and Oscar Piastri (McLaren) third.

ANSWER: Max Verstappen
